ownership: Provider bridges and public host IPC; no host identity or permission policy changes

regressions: Successful 20-record Slack and Discord history with historical speech over real NDJSON socket IO
Concurrent current-provider attestation retains exact original author, conversation and request correlation
Speech and send readers are parent scoped and expire on request completion
Stalled host admission, provider history and speech cancel before partial submission
The deadline is aggregate even when individual authorizations complete
External cancellation and permission revocation retain their distinct semantics
Late responses to canceled requests do not grant authority or terminate subsequent IPC
limits: The tests reproduce an unbounded pre-submission wait under a nonresponding dependency; they do not attribute an unobserved production wait to a particular dependency
The existing optional Discord SDK event-loop tests cannot run in this environment because discord.py is absent; provider-free Discord history and IPC tests pass
